description: This file implements the MPSDevice class and related functions for managing Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) devices on MacOS, including device initialization, version checks, and properties retrieval.

classes.name: MPSDevice
classes.description: Class managing the Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) device, including construction, destruction, device support checks, and property retrieval.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of MPSDevice.

methods.name: MPSDevice
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MPS device, selecting a suitable GPU device that supports Metal 2.0.

methods.name: ~MPSDevice
methods.description: Destructor releasing the Metal device reference.

methods.name: isMacOS13Plus
methods.description: Checks if the current MacOS version is at least a specified version.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the underlying Metal device.

methods.name: getCoreCount
methods.description: Retrieves the core count of the GPU device.
